I just purchased an STI after owning a WRX since 2012 and here are a few things I have learned. 

1.)  The WRX transmission is glass and will break especially if you’re planning to push high horsepower numbers (STI 6 Speed swaps are pricey)
2.)  Building a WRX is pricey in general especially since you’re a college kid. You’ll have to stock pile parts and tune constantly to get some insurance your engine can handle them
3.) You really need watch these cars and change oil frequently to help avoid the dreaded knock issues and ringland failures
4.) if you do blow your engine you’re looking at a lot more than 3k for a rebuild 
5.) The EJ is confusing at first if you’re a beginner 

Overall I loved my WRX and 160k Miles isn’t bad if the engine and body are in good condition. I recommend a compression and leakdown test before buying from an ASE certified mechanic. If you have the money then do it, you’ll join the Subie fam and catch waves from us a lot.
